The description fails to mention the key structural feature of the chart: that it is a grouped bar chart, where the bars for each method are clustered together for each category on the x-axis.

The description omits the 'PPO' method, which is one of the six methods shown in the chart.

errors.text_span: 刻度间隔为 1%

errors.evidence: In the Mathverse dataset, SRPO's accuracy is approximately 55.8%, which is one of the higher values in the group, not lower than others at ~53%. The description incorrectly identifies the bar and its value.

errors.evidence: In the MMLU dataset, DAPO's accuracy is approximately 55.8%. The value of 57% corresponds more closely to SRPO or DAPO+Self-reflection.

errors.text_span: 而 GRPO 的准确率约为 58%
errors.evidence: In the MMLU dataset, GRPO's accuracy is approximately 55.8%. No bar in this group reaches 58%.

errors.evidence: In the Physics dataset, 'DAPO+Self-reflection' has the highest accuracy (~61%), not 'SRPO' (~60.6%).

errors.text_span: GRPO in brown

errors.text_span: the tallest being GRPO at approximately 55%
errors.evidence: In the Mathverse dataset, the tallest bar corresponds to DAPO+Self-reflection at approximately 56.1%. The GRPO bar is one of the shortest, at approximately 53.3%.

errors.text_span: Dapo+Self-reflection has the shortest bar at approximately 57%
errors.evidence: In the MMLU dataset, the shortest bar is PPO at approximately 54.5%. The Dapo+Self-reflection bar is at approximately 56.8% and is not the shortest.

errors.text_span: while SRPO displays the tallest at approximately 59%
errors.evidence: In the MMLU dataset, the SRPO bar is the tallest, but its value is approximately 57.1%, not 59%. An error of nearly 2% is significant on this scale.

errors.text_span: The Physics dataset’s shortest bar is PPO at approximately 58%
errors.evidence: In the Physics dataset, the PPO bar is the shortest, but its value is approximately 56.8%, not 58%.

errors.text_span: and the tallest is SRPO, extending to approximately 61%
errors.evidence: In the Physics dataset, the tallest bar corresponds to DAPO+Self-reflection at approximately 61%. SRPO is the second tallest at about 60.6%.

errors.text_span: no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any of the bars
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Three of the six bar types (DAPO, GRPO, and PPO) have a distinct diagonal stripe pattern, which is a form of shading or patterning used for visual differentiation.

The description fails to mention the diagonal stripe pattern on three of the bars (DAPO, GRPO, PPO), which is a key feature for distinguishing them from their solid-colored counterparts (DAPO+Self-reflection, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection).

errors.text_span: GRPO (braun)
errors.evidence: The legend and bar chart show that GRPO is represented by a hatched orange bar, not a brown one.

errors.text_span: PPO + Self-reflection (hellgrün) und PPO (dunkelgrün)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns colors and misses the patterns. PPO + Self-reflection is solid green (the darker of the two greens), and PPO is hatched light green.
The description fails to mention that the bars for DAPO, GRPO, and PPO have a hatched pattern. This is a key visual feature used to distinguish methods with and without 'Self-reflection'.
